change.evidence: We've removed fast mode for Claude Opus 4.7. Requests to claude-opus-4-7 with speed: "fast" now return an error; unlike Claude Opus 4.6, they do not fall back to standard speed. Claude Opus 4.7 itself remains available at standard speed.

source: Recorded: the July 24, 2026 entry of server/api/src/monitor/fixtures/anthropic-release-notes-2026-10-17.html.gz, shaped as the classify phase reports a release-note change.
breakingChange: Fast mode was removed for Claude Opus 4.7, so a Messages request to claude-opus-4-7 with speed: "fast" is rejected with an invalid_request_error. src/review.js sends it on the beta Messages API with the fast-mode beta. src/explain.js calls the same model without speed and is not affected.
